text:
The bowl looks like a tuna salad in progress: flaked tuna, shredded carrot, diced celery, red onion, and some red pepper. There is no visible mayo yet.

I estimated the weights from the bowl size, which looks like roughly a 3-4 qt mixing bowl:
- Tuna: about 150 g, at roughly 1.1 kcal/g for canned tuna in water, so about 165 kcal.
- Carrot: about 50 g, so about 20 kcal.
- Celery, onion, and pepper: about 40 g, so about 10 kcal.

That comes to about 240 g of food and about 195 kcal. Tuna packed in oil would add more, so I rounded up to 210 kcal.
